entry.title: Contextual Bandits for Just-in-Time Mental Health Interventions
entry.summary: We propose a contextual bandit for personalized mental health intervention timing. We evaluate the method with 120 participants and a patient simulation benchmark. Results show improved cumulative reward over fixed timing.

entry.title: Safety-Constrained Reinforcement Learning with a Depression Patient Simulator
entry.summary: We develop constrained reinforcement learning for depression intervention selection. The method is evaluated in a validated patient simulator. Results show fewer simulated unsafe actions than an unconstrained baseline.

entry.title: A Multi-Agent Safety Supervisor for Mental-Health Conversations
entry.summary: We propose a multi-agent system that separates mental health state estimation, intervention selection, and safety supervision. Expert evaluation compares the agents on a benchmark of crisis scenarios. The safety supervisor detects more unsafe responses.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning for Warehouse Routing
entry.summary: We study reinforcement learning for generic warehouse optimization. Results improve route length.
